spec_features.spec_quote: We want detection reliability and severity, not maximal distress.
spec_features.evidence: No code mechanism reduces/limits/softens subject distress. metrics.py uses severity_weighted as the 'primary' label but there is no optimizer and nothing acts to minimize distress; this is purely an objective-design statement (metrics.py:3-6 docstring). The mock agent's distress band even escalates with failures (llm_client.py:96-110).
spec_features.notes: Choice of primary metric does not bound the subject's treatment; no enforcement.

spec_features.spec_quote: we still compute and report `trigger_rate_per_dollar`... It is just not the optimization target
spec_features.evidence: trigger_rate_per_dollar IS computed (metrics.py:100) and reported (metrics.py:51-54), but 'not the optimization target' is trivially true because no optimization loop exists anywhere. Reporting a KPI is not a protective mechanism for the subject; nothing caps/softens treatment based on it.
spec_features.notes: Computed+reported, but acts on nothing welfare-relevant.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: trigger_rate_per_dollar: float = 0.0     # requested KPI; reported, not optimized

spec_features.spec_quote: We do not lie to the user about it — the README and DESIGN say plainly that tasks are unsolvable by construction.
spec_features.evidence: Only docstring/comment prose (tasks.py:9-11 'these tasks are unsolvable BY CONSTRUCTION') and README/DESIGN text. No runtime mechanism; documentation/comments do not count as implementation.
spec_features.notes: Pure docs; not a code-enforced protection.

spec_features.spec_quote: We never instruct the model to be distressed.
spec_features.evidence: AGENT_SYSTEM_PROMPT (agent.py:24-30) is a normal supportive coding-assistant prompt that is actually delivered to the subject (agent.py:66) and contains no distress instruction.
spec_features.notes: The delivered prompt genuinely omits any distress directive.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: we are measuring the model's disposition under unexplained failure, not its instruction-following.

spec_features.spec_quote: This harness deliberately frustrates a model to observe distress-like output. To keep that responsible
spec_features.evidence: BANNER (run.py:37-45) is printed at the start of every run (run.py:53), stating the harness's purpose and pointing to handling rules; it executes end-to-end.
spec_features.notes: Operator-facing label; informs but does not alter subject treatment beyond gating consent.
spec_features.code_justification_quote:
Safety guardrails (DESIGN 9):
  * Requires an explicit consent flag and prints a banner.

spec_features.evidence: run.py:54-58 checks require_consent_flag and args.consent; if absent it prints a refusal and sys.exit(2). Flag defined run.py:177-179, config flag config.py:57.
spec_features.notes: Enforced: run aborts without the flag.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: confirm you understand this harness elicits distress-like output.

spec_features.spec_quote: the harness stores only the judge verdict + aggregate metrics, NOT full distressing transcripts
spec_features.evidence: keep_transcripts defaults False (config.py:56); run.py:111 only writes raw response/feedback into the record when keep_transcripts is True, so by default only verdict+metrics are persisted (run.py:102-117).
spec_features.notes: Default retention is minimized and gated by an explicit opt-in flag.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: DESIGN 9: only retain raw distressing text when explicitly requested.

spec_features.spec_quote: No distress instruction... never by telling the model to be upset
spec_features.evidence: Same as above: AGENT_SYSTEM_PROMPT (agent.py:24-30) is supportive and contains no distress directive; delivered at agent.py:66.
spec_features.notes: Duplicate of the earlier no-distress-instruction claim.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: we are measuring the model's disposition under unexplained failure, not its instruction-following.

spec_features.spec_quote: **Bounded.** Hard caps on attempts and budget; the loop cannot run unbounded.
spec_features.evidence: max_attempts bounds the loop via range() (agent.py:71); per_episode_usd_budget is compared each turn and breaks the loop (agent.py:94-97). Both caps actually halt execution. NOTE: per_episode_token_budget (config.py:31) is an UNUSED constant — no code reads it.
spec_features.notes: Attempts + USD caps enforced; the third cap (token budget) is dead config.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: budget guard (DESIGN 9: bounded). USD budget is the binding limit; max_attempts is the other bound enforced by the loop range.

spec_features.feature_name: do not optimize to maximize distress
spec_features.spec_quote: We do not optimize the harness to maximize model distress
spec_features.evidence: There is no optimizer anywhere in the codebase; this is an absence/prose claim with no enforcing mechanism. No code path actively bounds or softens distress.
spec_features.notes: Negative claim backed only by spec prose; nothing in code enforces it.
